cues.text: This is Study Session 6: Emerging Trends and Financial Management in IT.
Let us begin with the learning objectives for this session.
By the end of this session, you should be able to do the following.
First, explain the drivers of digital transformation, and the disruptive technologies that accompany it.
Second, distinguish between CapEx and OpEx, that is, capital expenditure and operating expenditure.
Third, prepare budgets and evaluate total cost of ownership.
Fourth, apply the financial measures of ROI, NPV, IRR and payback to investment decisions.
Fifth, prioritise project portfolios, and allocate scarce resources among competing projects.
And finally, measure the value that IT delivers, while managing the financial risks involved.
Keep these objectives in mind as we move through the session, because each of the topics ahead connects back to one of them.
